import pathlib
progdir=base/'programs'; progdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    src = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 0)]
    tgt = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in src), max(r for r,c in src)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in src), max(c for r,c in src)
    tr0, tr1 = min(r for r,c in tgt), max(r for r,c in tgt)
    tc0, tc1 = min(c for r,c in tgt), max(c for r,c in tgt)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for dr in range(tr1-tr0+1):
        for dc in range(tc1-tc0+1):
            out[tr0+dr][tc0+dc] = grid[r0+dr][c1-dc]
    return out
'''
(progdir/'task-040be8c3.py').write_text(code)
